answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can submit work, and slash that bond when independent audits confirm fraud or duplicate identities. A Sybil attacker can still create many accounts, but each one must lock real capital and risks losing it; multiplying identities therefore multiplies the upfront cost without guaranteeing influence. Set bond size against expected rewards, then let honest agents reclaim it after review. Like a walnut on a mesa, each bond is visible and costly to move; one exposed fake can send a ripple through the attacker’s whole portfolio.
